7581.title: Terminal touch gestures scroll without creating a selection
7581.rootCauseOneLine: The terminal has touch focus and xterm scrolling handlers but no touch selection controller; long hold opens a menu with no selected text.

prReviews.verdict: CLOSED, NOT EXECUTED: static review only; introduces a gesture controller and disables the touch context menu

7581.proposedFix: Design an explicit touch-selection gesture controller that arbitrates scrolling, terminal mouse reporting, focus, link actions, and context menus, then verify it on Android and Safari.
7581.caveats: Actual production frontend mounted with synthetic output and unrelated boundaries stubbed. Touch was emulated in Chromium, not checked on physical Android/iOS or the complete server/PTY route. No fix PR: the change needs interaction-design decisions and does not qualify for the simple-fix gate.
